resources.string: This host applies the saved proxy when the session starts, so a changed address or password applies the next time Natune launches. The proxy covers catalog, YouTube, Last.fm and upload requests, and playback audio follows the same route unless the stream bypass switch is on. The stream route is picked up live, so rotation and bypass edits need no restart: IP rotation sends each new playback connection through the next validated proxy, while catalog and browse requests keep the session route. DNS-over-HTTPS is not offered because iOS gives an app no DNS hook for its HTTP sessions. The YouTube region applies through the YouTube session refresh. Now-playing artwork, Listen Together, listener presence and Japanese pack downloads use the system connection. Localhost, loopback addresses and *.local hosts bypass the proxy. An HTTP proxy password is answered only when the proxy asks for it. A SOCKS proxy password is best effort on this host.
